definitions.providerElapsedMs: Parent-observed admission/transport interval; includes child startup when enabled, not server-only inference.
definitions.scenarioElapsedMs: Runner-observed setup, sign-in, uploads, indexing and both assistant jobs; not user completion time.
definitions.queueDelayMs: API request transaction to first RUNNING worker outbox transaction; includes messaging/scheduling. Null if not exported. Invalid intervals excluded and listed.
definitions.jobEndToEndMs: API request transaction to terminal API job update; includes worker processing and completion delivery. Invalid intervals excluded and listed.
definitions.accountedUsd: Dated local pricing estimate plus full unknown reservations; not a provider invoice.

limitations: Sequential local synthetic run, not a controlled load benchmark.
Host sleep, startup, polling and other concurrent work can affect observations.
Wall-clock timestamps are not monotonic; negative intervals are preserved as anomalies, never clamped to zero.
Failed and unknown costs remain accounted; no user time-saving claim.
